headline: BLB Limited announces the resignation of internal auditors Sarat Jain and Associates
hook: Auditor steps down ahead of schedule
summary: BLB Limited has informed the stock exchange that M/s. Sarat Jain and Associates have resigned from their position as internal auditors of the company. The resignation is effective from October 01, 2026. Internal auditor changes require scrutiny for corporate governance stability. Retail investors should note this administrative shift in the company's financial oversight.
whats_next: Appointment of new internal auditors by BLB Limited
why_it_matters: Auditor changes require monitoring for corporate governance transparency.
